capabilities: restrict watched list properties to a single value
overwrite the old value when a new one is added
configure which property names to watch
show an optional notice when values are trimmed
disambiguation: Does not add a true single-select property type; it only trims a watched list property to its last value after you edit it.
extras: Bilingual README (English and Chinese). The author accepts Ko-fi donations. The README states the plugin becomes unnecessary once Obsidian natively supports single-select properties.
intentEvidence: Once Obsidian supports "single-select" property, this plugin will no longer be necessary.
motivation: The author found repeatedly deleting the old value before adding a new one tedious and wrote the plugin to automate that step.
problem: Obsidian list properties accept multiple values, so single-choice fields like status or priority require manually deleting the old value before adding a new one.

relations.evidence: this plugin is the source of inspiration for me to create SCP

summary: Property plugin that keeps watched list properties, such as status, limited to one value by overwriting old entries when a new one is added.
